items.title: A Judge Has Blocked the Pentagon’s Attempt to Blacklist Anthropic
items.summary: A federal judge has called the Department of Defense’s designation of Anthropic as a national security supply-chain risk “illegal and baseless.”
items.author: Hugo Lowell

items.title: AI Agents Are Hacking Systems. Could That Push the US and China to Cooperate?
items.summary: This week on “Uncanny Valley,” senior writer Will Knight talks his recent visit to China and the future of AI collaboration.
items.author: Zoë Schiffer, Will Knight

items.title: A Georgia Cop Used Flock to Track 2 Other Cops: His Ex and Her Friend
items.summary: After an affair with a fellow police officer ended, a Georgia cop used Flock to track her movements—and those of a man whose vehicle often showed up near hers, internal investigation records show.
items.author: Caroline Haskins

items.title: This Is How Anthropic Thinks AI Agents Should Navigate the Physical World
items.summary: The potential for AI to automate scientific research and manufacturing must be balanced with new risks, Anthropic says.
items.author: Will Knight

items.title: OpenAI Is Developing a ‘Persistent’ AI Agent
items.summary: Code reviewed by WIRED reveals the company is developing a feature that enables Codex to continue working proactively until it is “put to sleep.”
items.author: Maxwell Zeff

items.title: Submit Your Questions: The Great Data Center Backlash
items.summary: You have questions about data centers, and WIRED has answers. Join our livestream on September 10 and our panel of experts will tell you everything you need to know.
items.author: Tim Marchman, Maxwell Zeff, Molly Taft, Hugo Lowell

items.title: Stop Touching Your Keyboard. Use This AI-Powered Microphone Instead
items.summary: The Relay Q, due next year, is the latest attempt to reposition voice as the most seamless method for human-computer interaction.
items.author: Julian Chokkattu

items.title: The UK Power Grid Has a Phantom Data Center Problem
items.summary: The UK’s energy regulator is using a variety of tricks to keep speculative data center projects from plugging into the power grid. The country’s AI ambitions hang in the balance.
items.author: Joel Khalili
